# HEIC decoding

The demo loads the unmodified ES module from heic-to 1.6.7 when the browser needs help decoding a HEIC image. The package incorporates libheif. The module and its corresponding build sources are available in the exact upstream distribution. [Versioned source distribution](https://registry.npmjs.org/heic-to/-/heic-to-1.6.7.tgz) · [Upstream project](https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to) · [Upstream license notice](heic-to-LICENSE.txt) · [LGPL 3.0](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html)
